name: mosaic-foundations
title: mosaic-foundations
description: MOSAIC Foundations — a capabilities showcase. One runnable study per model type, each grounded in MOSAIC biology, demonstrating the variety the framework supports: dynamic FBA (metabolism), community ODE gLV (vaginal BV, Stein 2013, inline Antimony via viva-tellurium), kinetic/PK-PD ODE (estrogen enterohepatic recycling, inline Antimony), spatial/ABM (viva-munk particle colony, viva-cpm gut crypt, vivarium-tyssue epithelial sheet), and process-bigraph composition coupling two of them. Serves as the clear foundation the three science Aims build on.
